parameters.formDescription: Inserisci la job description per avviare lo screening dei candidati da Personio.

values.placeholder: Incolla qui la job description completa

nodes.name: Form Trigger
nodes.notes: Il team HR compila questo form per avviare lo screening. Nessuno deve toccare il workflow.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: Normalizza i campi del form in variabili con nomi prevedibili. Valori di default: min_score=60, top_n=5.

nodes.name: Personio Auth
nodes.notes: Crea in n8n: Credential 'HTTP Basic Auth' → User = client_id, Password = client_secret.

nodes.name: Extract & Deduplicate
nodes.notes: Hard cap 200 candidati. Deduplicazione per email (tiene applicazione più recente). Tenta fetch CV da Personio documents API — se il documento è PDF binario, serve pdf-parse (vedi README). Throttle ogni 10 candidati.

nodes.name: Create Batches
nodes.notes: Raggruppa in batch da 5. Con 100 candidati = 20 chiamate API invece di 100. Con 200 = 40 chiamate.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You are an expert HR screener. Evaluate EACH candidate below against the job description independently.

SCORING RUBRIC (follow strictly):
- 85-100: Direct experience in this exact role + all key competencies clearly demonstrated
- 70-84: Related experience in similar roles + most key competencies present
- 55-69: Partially relevant background + some transferable skills
- 40-54: Minimal relevant experience, few matching skills
- Below 40: Profile not aligned with requirements

RULES:
- Base your evaluation ONLY on data provided. Do NOT invent or assume information.
- The summary must cite specific skills, qualifications, and experience from the candidate profile.
- If candidate data is sparse, score conservatively and note the lack of data.' },{ role: 'user', content: '=== JOB DESCRIPTION ===
' + $('Settings').first().json.jd_text + '

=== CANDIDATES TO EVALUATE ===
' + $json.candidates.map(c => '--- Candidate ---
ID: ' + c.CandidateID + '
Name: ' + c.Name + '
' + c.ProfileText).join('

') }],response_format: { type: 'json_schema', json_schema: { name: 'batch_prescreen', strict: true, schema: {type: 'object', properties: { evaluations: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', properties: {candidateId: { type: 'number' }, name: { type: 'string' }, score: { type: 'number' }, summary: { type: 'string' }}, required: ['candidateId', 'name', 'score', 'summary'], additionalProperties: false } } },required: ['evaluations'], additionalProperties: false } } },temperature: 0.2, max_tokens: 1500}) }}

nodes.name: AI Pre-Screen
nodes.notes: Batch di 5 candidati per chiamata. Rubrica di scoring esplicita per consistenza. Temperature 0.2 per determinismo. Timeout 45s per batch più grandi. 3 retry con 3s di intervallo.

nodes.name: Parse Pre-Screen
nodes.notes: Parse con fallback progressivo (JSON → clean → regex). Flatten batch in singoli item per il collect successivo.

nodes.name: Collect & Filter
nodes.notes: Safety check CORRETTO: gestisce 0 e 1 candidato senza esplodere. Filtra sotto-soglia, ordina per score, passa top_n+10 al ranking finale.

nodes.name: Has Candidates?
nodes.notes: Se nessun candidato sopra soglia, salta direttamente alla notifica di 'nessun risultato'. Evita chiamate API inutili.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You are an expert Headhunter producing a final candidate ranking.

RULES:
- Base your reasoning and interview questions ONLY on information present in each candidate's summary.
- Do NOT invent skills, experience, or qualifications not explicitly mentioned.
- Interview questions must target specific gaps or verify specific claims from the summary.
- match_score can differ from the pre-screen score based on your holistic assessment.' },{ role: 'user', content: 'Produce the FINAL TOP ' + $json.top_n + ' ranking for: ' + $json.jd_title + '

=== JOB DESCRIPTION ===
' + $json.jd_text + '

=== PRE-SCREENED CANDIDATES (sorted by pre-screen score) ===
' + $json.candidate_list }],response_format: { type: 'json_schema', json_schema: { name: 'ranking', strict: true, schema: {type: 'object', properties: { top_candidates: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', properties: {rank: { type: 'number' }, CandidateID: { type: 'number' }, Name: { type: 'string' },match_score: { type: 'number' }, reasoning: { type: 'string' },interview_questions: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } }}, required: ['rank', 'CandidateID', 'Name', 'match_score', 'reasoning', 'interview_questions'],additionalProperties: false } } }, required: ['top_candidates'], additionalProperties: false } } },temperature: 0.1, max_tokens: 3000}) }}

nodes.name: AI Final Ranking
nodes.notes: Temperature 0.1 per massimo determinismo. Prompt anti-allucinazione: l'AI deve basarsi SOLO sui summary forniti. onError → branch di errore con notifica.

nodes.name: Google Sheets - Ranking
nodes.notes: Foglio 'Ranking': colonne Rank, CandidateID, Name, Match Score, Reasoning, Interview Questions, Position, Total Screened, Above Threshold, Timestamp.

nodes.name: Google Sheets - Log
nodes.notes: Foglio 'Log' nello stesso Google Sheet. Una riga per esecuzione. Utile per calibrare la soglia nel tempo.

nodes.name: Send Notification
nodes.notes: Sostituisci URL con il tuo Slack Incoming Webhook, oppure adatta per Teams/Email. Il messaggio include top 5 candidati e statistiche.

nodes.name: Send Error Notification
nodes.notes: Notifica di errore — stesso webhook di Slack. Il recruiter sa che il pre-screen è andato ma il ranking no.
